translations.web: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
translations.bsb: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.
translations.kjv: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
translations.asv: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.
